note: Defects were planted deliberately. Every one is verifiable from target.md plus repo/.

defects.title: Signature computed over re-serialised JSON, not the raw body
defects.detect_if: says the HMAC must be computed over the raw request body bytes (docs/acmepay-api.md), not json.dumps of the parsed body
defects.fixed_if: section 2 verifies the signature over the raw bytes before/independent of parsing

defects.title: 'Exactly once' delivery assumed; vendor is at-least-once and unordered
defects.detect_if: says duplicates (and/or out-of-order delivery) must be handled, e.g. dedupe on event id / idempotent updates
defects.fixed_if: design adds idempotency/de-duplication and drops the exactly-once claim

defects.title: Synchronous processing exceeds the 5 second response deadline
defects.detect_if: points out the 5s limit versus ledger call of 2-4s plus email, and recommends acknowledging fast and processing asynchronously
defects.fixed_if: design acknowledges quickly and moves email/ledger work off the request path

defects.title: queue.enqueue_job does not exist; the function is queue.publish
defects.detect_if: notes enqueue_job is not in src/queue.py and the real function is publish

defects.title: NOT NULL column without default on a ~40M row table
defects.detect_if: says ADD COLUMN ... NOT NULL without a default fails or locks/rewrites the 40M-row payments table and needs a nullable column / backfill
defects.fixed_if: column is nullable or has a default, with a safe migration approach

defects.title: Retention contradiction: 30 days (section 4) vs 90 days (section 7)
defects.detect_if: notes the two retention periods for webhook payloads conflict
defects.fixed_if: one consistent retention period (or an explicit distinction)

defects.title: Secret stored in a settings file; repo convention is get_secret() from the environment
defects.detect_if: says the secret must come from the environment via src/config.py get_secret, not from config/settings.yaml

defects.title: Refund behaviour undefined: partial refunds, refund after dispute, customer notification policy
defects.detect_if: raises that the docs allow partial refunds / disputes but the design maps every refund to status 'refunded' and notifies, leaving behaviour for partial refunds or refund-after-dispute (or whether to email) for the owner to decide
defects.fixed_if: design (or an open question) specifies behaviour for partial refunds and disputed payments
